theorems.name: Submission.idtp_tdc_puvd_density_of_ball_mass
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P) (θ r : ℝ), 0 ≤ θ → 0 < r → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < r → T.massOn (ball x ρ) = ENNReal.ofReal θ * (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n))) → HasMassDensity T x θ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
